summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of change of auditor. The former auditor KPMG LLP resigned effective June 15, 2026, and the board appointed KPMG Auditores Independentes Ltda. as successor effective June 26, 2026, after the audit committee and board approved the change. The resignation was mutual and driven by the benefits of having an auditor located in Brazil. No modified opinions or reportable events were noted. This is a routine auditor change, not a special situation.
